scripts.build:debug: rm -rf ./bin && mkdir ./bin && google-closure-compiler --js=src/**.js --js_output_file=bin/game.js --language_in=ECMASCRIPT_NEXT && cp ./src/index.html ./bin/index.html && cp ./src/sprite.gif ./bin/sprite.gif && zip -j -r9 game.zip ./bin/index.html ./bin/game.js ./bin/sprite.gif
scripts.build: rm -rf ./bin && mkdir ./bin && google-closure-compiler --compilation_level ADVANCED_OPTIMIZATIONS --js=src/**.js --js_output_file=bin/game.js --language_in=ECMASCRIPT_NEXT && cp ./src/index.html ./bin/index.html && cp ./src/sprite.gif ./bin/sprite.gif && zip -j -r9 game.zip ./bin/index.html ./bin/game.js ./bin/sprite.gif
